lines.zh: 沼泽的水到脚踝，我走得很慢。
lines.en: The swamp reaches my ankles; I wade slowly.
I step over rotten wood without a sound.

lines.zh: 红树的根缠在泥里，我绕过去。
lines.en: Mangrove roots coil in the mud; I go around.

lines.zh: 我掂了掂手里的瓶子，够用。
lines.en: I weigh the bottle in my hand. Enough.

lines.zh: 斗篷下摆拖着泥，我不介意。
lines.en: My robe hem drags in the mud. I don't mind.
The fog is thick. Good cover.

lines.zh: 我走路有点歪，草鞋进水了。
lines.en: I walk a little crooked; my shoes are full of water.
I know this swamp well.
I'm looking for something to brew with.
I slip and catch myself on a tree.
A frog hops away. I ignore it.
I look up. Rain is coming.

lines.zh: 我把手伸进沼泽，摸了一手泥。
lines.en: I reach into the swamp and come up with mud.

lines.zh: 红树林沼泽的水，比这里还浑。
lines.en: The mangrove swamp water is even murkier.

lines.zh: 我搅了搅药瓶，颜色不对。
lines.en: I swirl the bottle. Wrong colour.
I laugh, but very quietly.

lines.zh: 帽檐压得很低，看不见我眼睛。
lines.en: My brim sits low; my eyes stay hidden.

lines.zh: 这种地方，没有人愿意来。
lines.en: Nobody wants to come to a place like this.
I'm counting the footprints in the mud.

lines.zh: 沼泽的气味，闻久了就习惯。
lines.en: Breathe the swamp long enough and it's normal.

lines.zh: 一根树枝上挂着我的东西。
lines.en: Something of mine hangs on a branch.
I stir slowly, waiting for the colour to turn.

lines.zh: 没人来，我就在这儿站着。
lines.en: No one comes. So I stand here.
Plenty of mosquitoes. I don't swat them.

lines.zh: 我把潮湿的头发拨到耳后。
lines.en: I push my damp hair behind an ear.

lines.zh: 这种安静，说明附近有东西。
lines.en: Quiet like this means something's near.

lines.zh: 脚下的水，慢慢渗进泥里。
lines.en: The water at my feet seeps slowly into mud.

lines.zh: 我抬头看了看月亮的位置。
lines.en: I check where the moon sits.
The brew needs a little more heat.
I stand at the water's edge and don't move.

lines.zh: 你走到沼泽里来，是为我？
lines.en: You walked into the swamp — for me?

lines.zh: 我抬起头，帽檐下没有笑意。
lines.en: I lift my head. No smile under the brim.
Those boots are worth a few coins.
One look, and I've remembered you.
Care to sample my craft?
I don't often speak with the living.
The swamp mist answers to me.

lines.zh: 我伸手，指了指你的胸口。
lines.en: I reach out and point at your chest.

lines.zh: 这沼泽吞过比你壮的人。
lines.en: This swamp has swallowed stronger than you.

lines.zh: 你再多站一会儿，就会不舒服。
lines.en: Stand there a little longer and you'll feel unwell.
I smile slowly. You didn't see it.

lines.zh: 退出去，我还能当没见过你。
lines.en: Walk out now and I'll forget I saw you.

lines.zh: 这一下，我会还你一剂药。
lines.en: For that, I'll pay you back with a potion.
I fall back, robe shielding my body.
My hat's askew. That won't do.
One bottle broke. A pity.
The swamp mud sucks at my boots.
That changed my mind.

lines.zh: 斗篷下我还有别的东西。
lines.en: I have more than looks under this cloak.
The mud is moving. You'd best leave.
I retreat to the water's edge, steady.
I'll settle this account slowly.
That bottle — I know that shape.

lines.zh: 你带来的东西，有点意思。
lines.en: What you've brought is interesting.
When I reach out, you should be wary.
I sniff. That smell is familiar.
Hand it over. I'll keep it safe.
I narrow my eyes and do the sums.

lines.zh: 沼泽里没有这样的东西。
lines.en: Nothing like that grows in this swamp.

lines.zh: 我不贪，只是想要一点点。
lines.en: I'm not greedy. Just a little.
Held like that, it'll bring trouble.

lines.zh: 我摊开手，等你自己放上来。
lines.en: I open my palm and wait for you to place it there.
Bump into me and you'll carry my smell.

lines.zh: 我退开一步，斗篷沾了泥。
lines.en: I step back; my robe picks up mud.
The swamp is crowded as it is.
Don't step on my herb patch.
I go around without touching you.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我手里的瓶子晃了。
lines.en: That knock sloshed the bottle in my hand.
Don't touch my sleeve.

lines.zh: 我站稳了，泥在鞋上厚了一层。
lines.en: I steady myself; the mud thickens on my shoes.

lines.zh: 你这么沉，撞得我退了半步。
lines.en: You're heavy; I give half a step.
Next time go the long way round.
This needs no witnesses.

lines.zh: 我把手按在水面上，念了句什么。
lines.en: I press a hand to the water and murmur something.

lines.zh: 沼泽的雾把我们围在中间。
lines.en: The swamp fog closes around us.
Bubbles rise from the mud, one by one.
I press my forehead to theirs. Cold.

lines.zh: 我们都不说话，只听着水。
lines.en: Neither of us speaks; we listen to the water.
The swamp will remember tonight.

lines.zh: 我的手指上沾了药的味道。
lines.en: My fingers smell of potion.
I'll be gone before dawn.
Leaving a little behind is enough.
I pick it up and drop it into a bottle.
This leaf will brew.

lines.zh: 泥里的东西，往往最有用。
lines.en: The things in mud are often the most useful.
I weigh it. Not dried enough.
I tuck it carefully into my robe.
Not this. Too filthy.

lines.zh: 我把瓶子举起来对着雾看。
lines.en: I hold the bottle up against the fog.
A mushroom. Perfect.
I crush it and sniff.
This swamp lacks nothing.
You've stepped into my ground.
I don't shout. I simply raise a hand.
The swamp will do the work for me.

lines.zh: 这一片泥，认得我的脚步。
lines.en: This mud knows my footsteps.

lines.zh: 我摸出一瓶东西，摇了摇。
lines.en: I pull out a bottle and shake it.

lines.zh: 你要留下来，就留在这里。
lines.en: If you're staying, you'll stay right here.

lines.zh: 我的手指在袖子里动了。
lines.en: My fingers move inside my sleeve.
No one will hear in the mangroves.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，是为了看得更全。
lines.en: I step back to see the whole of you.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水，已经记住你了。
lines.en: The swamp water has already marked you.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的脚，一步都不放。
lines.en: I watch your feet and miss no step.

lines.zh: 水花一响，我就知道你走哪。
lines.en: One splash tells me where you went.
I switch the bottle to my left hand.
The deeper you go, the harder to leave.
I've scattered powder through the swamp.
The fog is on my side.
I lift a hand and the mud bubbles.
I can count your breaths.
You won't circle out of this one.

lines.zh: 我一直没动，才是最可怕的。
lines.en: The fact I haven't moved is the worst part.

lines.zh: 我把瓶子砸出去，碎了一地。
lines.en: I hurl the bottle and it shatters.

lines.zh: 我的手抓过去，指甲很长。
lines.en: My hand rakes out, nails long.
Violet mist spills from the bottle's mouth.
You're standing still. That means it worked.
I smile as you retreat.
Not a heavy blow. Only the beginning.
The mud starts climbing your feet.
I step away and let the swamp take over.

lines.zh: 你手上有味道了，跑不掉的。
lines.en: You carry my scent now. You won't escape.
I pull my robe tight and withdraw.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水冒了个泡，我出来了。
lines.en: The swamp water bubbles and I rise out.

lines.zh: 我站在红树根上，斗篷还在滴水。
lines.en: I stand on mangrove roots, robe still dripping.
I know this place by its smell.
The fog welcomes me more warmly than people do.

lines.zh: 我理了理袖子，看了一圈。
lines.en: I smooth my sleeves and look around.

lines.zh: 沼泽里的东西，都在看我。
lines.en: Everything in the swamp is watching me.

lines.zh: 我把药瓶摆好，一共三个。
lines.en: I line up my bottles — three of them.
This mud will grow things nicely.
Where I came from doesn't matter.
You'd all do well to stay away.

lines.zh: 我笑了，声音在雾里散开。
lines.en: I laugh, and it scatters in the fog.
The swamp will speak for me.

lines.zh: 斗篷焦了一角，药味更冲。
lines.en: A corner of my cloak burns and the fumes sharpen.

lines.zh: 我从树上落下，骨头都震了。
lines.en: I fall from a tree and my bones jar.

lines.zh: 沼泽吞了我半截，我呛了水。
lines.en: The swamp swallows me halfway and I choke.

lines.zh: 炸得泥水四溅，我站不稳。
lines.en: The blast sprays mud and water; I can't stand.

lines.zh: 有东西钉进肩膀，我拔了。
lines.en: Something pins my shoulder; I pull it out.

lines.zh: 有人用我的东西对付我。
lines.en: Someone's turned my own craft against me.

lines.zh: 药熬了太久，我什么都没吃。
lines.en: Too long brewing, and I've eaten nothing.

lines.zh: 雷打进沼泽，我全身发麻。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the swamp and numbs me.

lines.zh: 沼泽下面，原来还有更深的空。
lines.en: Below the swamp, there's a deeper emptiness.
